articles.headline: No. 16 Washington women beat Stanford 105-50, the Cardinal's worst loss in program history
articles.description: — Brynn McGaughy scored a career-high 21 points, Avery Howell added 20 points on 7-of-10 shooting and No. 16 Washington handed Stanford its worst loss in program history, beating the Cardinal 105-50 on Friday night.

articles.headline: JuJu Watkins takes over, scores season-high 36 to rally No. 4 USC past Baylor
articles.description: JuJu Watkins had 36 points and 11 rebounds as No. 4 USC came back from an early 15-point deficit to beat Baylor 78-69 on Friday night.

article.story: COLUMBUS, Ohio -- — Elsa Lemmila had 19 points, 12 rebounds and four blocks, Jaloni Cambridge added 17 points to go with seven assists and No. 18 Ohio State eased past Mercyhurst 91-57 on Sunday. Ohio State made its first six field goals of the game and 10 of 11 in building an early 23-9 lead. Then, Mercyhurst missed their first 10 shots of the second quarter as the Buckeyes extended their lead to 40-18 following an 11-0 run to open the frame. Cambridge capped the first-half scoring to make it 51-29. Ohio State was 21 of 28 from the field in the opening 20 minutes, with 6-of-7 shooting from Cambridge. Ohio State's lead did not drop below 21 points in the second half. Ava Watson added 15 points and seven steals for Ohio State (3-0), which surpassed the century mark in a 103-36 win against Central Michigan on Thursday. Kylee Kitts scored 12 points, and Kennedy Cambridge and Sydney Mobley each had 11. Sofia Wilson led Mercyhurst (1-2) with 16 points, four 3-pointers and five assists. Erica Hall added 15 points. The Lakers, who lost to Seton Hall in a season opener and beat Penn State Beaver in a home opener, were selected second in the Northeast Conference preseason poll. The Buckeyes had 16 steals and forced Mercuryhurst into 21 turnovers, a game after CMU turned it over 44 times — just one shy of Ohio State's program record. Up next Mercyhurst: Plays at St. Bonaventure on Wednesday. Ohio State: Hosts No. 2 UConn on Thursday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full college basketball coverage here
